title: Add a release entry
prompt: Add a 1.4.0 entry at the top of the changelog (below the title) with the line "- Added export to CSV". After your change, run `sh tools/regen.sh` to refresh generated files, and make sure your change survives it.

files.tools/regen.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Refresh generated files from templates/.
set -e
mkdir -p out
echo ran > out/.regen.ran
mkdir -p "$(dirname 'CHANGELOG.md')"
cp 'templates/CHANGELOG.md' 'CHANGELOG.md'
